people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Aroer
people.line: A city in Gad, built by the Gadites.

people.name: Gilead

translations.web: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;
